run_populate_js_test_data: run the script to generate binary search data files for JavaScript search testing
generate_search_data_binaries: generate serialized search data binaries for all type size combinations using Trie and ResultMap
create_error_handling_test_files: create test binary files with wrong magic, version, or size to verify error handling
serialize_unicode_search_data: serialize search data with UTF-8 names like Hýždě and Hárá into binary format
build_nested_namespace_trie: build a Trie with heavily nested namespace entries like Magnum::Math::Geometry::Range
